text:
arjun: pushed an RBAC shrink for keystore roles in ap-south during the 02:30 maintenance window. now seeing mtls handshake errors and a proxy 5xx uptick. anyone seeing KMS denies?

maria: seeing a spike at ~02:38. logs and alert link: https://logs.internal/redwood/ap-south?ctx=handshake

devon: oncall, grabbing pod list and traces. will check pprof after pod churn.

rebecca: audit stream shows KMS::DecryptDenied and KMS::UnwrapDenied for serviceAccount:redwood-proxy between 02:36-02:41. also a RoleBinding change at 02:34.

sre-bot: alert: mtls-handshake-failure-rate > 5% (region=ap-south) 02:39 — paging oncall.

arjun: pasted sanitized proxy logs: 

```
proxy.ERROR: tls handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
k8s.audit: RoleBinding "keystore-client-binding" modified - removed subject svcaccount:redwood-proxy
kms.ERROR: AccessDenied: DecryptDenied for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-role
kms.ERROR: UnwrapDenied for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-role
```

maria: looks like we conflated Decrypt and Unwrap permissions in the new RBAC policy. proxies need Unwrap (envelope key flow) not just Decrypt.

devon: mitigation plan: rolling back RBAC change now `git revert 7b4c1ee && ./deploy rollback --region=ap-south`. ETA ~5m.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated (region=ap-south) id=rb-4412 user=devon ETA=5m

rebecca: hypothesis: the role-binding prune removed Unwrap/keystore:unwrap capability for the proxy SA; fetching cert material failed, causing handshake termination.

arjun: confirmed envelope-keying requires UnwrapKey or keystore:unwrap. our permission matrix mistakenly mapped both to a single "decrypt" label.

maria: post-mitigation suggestions: 1) add a CI preflight that runs a synthetic mtls handshake against a staging keystore, 2) require a canary RBAC rollout in one region with mtls smoke checks, 3) add KMS deny alerts (DecryptDenied and UnwrapDenied).

devon: agree. adding to deploy playbook: RBAC keystore changes must go canary + mtls healthcheck.

security-bot: created incident SEC-2026 with tags [rbac,kms,mtls,ap-south], assigned to @rebecca.

rebecca: preparing a PR to restore minimal Unwrap permission and add an integration test that requests a certificate via the keystore, verifying unwrap path. pinging @devex to add a lightweight hint test to quickstart.

arjun: rollback restored metrics to baseline around 02:49. next actions: restore Unwrap scope, update RBAC PR with explicit keystore action mapping, add audit alert and dashboard for KMS denies, add runbook entry for keystore RBAC changes.

maria: I'll create a Grafana panel tracking KMS:DecryptDenied and KMS:UnwrapDenied on a per-region basis and extend retention for keystore audit logs to 90 days.

devon: I'll update the runbook and deploy checklist so RBAC changes touching keystore require Canary + mtls check and a pair of approvers (security + platform).

arjun: also recommend a periodic rolebinding-diff across clusters to catch accidental divergence from baseline.

rebecca: running a rolebinding diff now across prod clusters, will post results and any mismatches.

maria: thanks :thumbsup:

devon: oncall handoff in 1h, will monitor alerts. :eyes:

sre-bot: alert cleared: mtls-handshake-failure-rate returned to baseline (02:49).

security-bot: incident SEC-2026 updated to state=mitigated; next steps=postmortem + RBAC policy fixes.

arjun: I'll start a short postmortem draft summarizing the unwrap vs decrypt distinction and the mitigation timeline. anyone else?

maria: nothing else from security, will attach the new dashboard.

devon: will follow up on playbook change.

rebecca: PR link will be added to the incident and request review.

arjun: thanks team. lesson learned: narrowing scope is good but we must codify exact keystore action semantics in RBAC and ensure regression tests for critical infra paths.
